See docs/notes/priority-monism-framework.md#can-a-necessary-wholes-essential-differences-identify-a-receiver-of-its-esse-1811 and Scratch/necessary-whole/Differentiation.lean. Exchanging the slots preserves #1097 actual parthood, existence and whole-first support; a role invariant under this exchange cannot select a unique actual atom. A coupled spring response illustrates how different collective modes can still be distinguished without privileging a constituent. Knowledge and power can have different success criteria before assigning them to particularized constituents. For the same W, a factive cognitive alternative differing on a selected truth establishes a local deficit if W’s whole cognitive basis cannot discriminate it and possession requires such discernment. Given d164b1ff on that same possession relation and the existing four reception premises, the local proof obtains DistinctEsseAt for actual W and double-negated reception in its own essence. Positive reception there follows with local excluded middle. With d1f3ffcc and b62a64ab the distinction gives a different cause of this W’s esse. None of the tests derives the cognitive deficit or its status as a perfection of being from essential plurality, nor identifies a trope as the receiver. Distinct existence ground at the selected world additionally requires the cb1cdea9 interface. No new registered proof, source attribution or premise effect.

Remaining blocker is a defended actual-object functional/essential-individuation-to-entity-priority D bridge, plus separate productive-power/esse applicability. Its three-node transitive consequences do not select or prove WF of the whole actual relation. Recommend live319 composite-to-actual-uniting-cause interface rather than another ungrounded graph completion; see note for exact target/interfaces. Earlier all-intermediate-edge requirement question is resolved and not reopened. No claim that intermediate edges are absent or that the candidate is refuted. #1811: the necessary presence of a knowing trope does not fix its complete cognitive basis. Test a settled contrast against the whole’s independently specified cognitive access and justify intrinsic possession in the fullness premise, or give an independent individuation and content account for a unique necessary trope. Whether the instantiated whole has a noncopy sufficient intrinsic existence reason remains open.
